criteria.reason: The available passage concerns older men receiving 5 mg for prostate disease and explicitly excludes 1 mg hair-loss treatment. It supplies neither the claimed causal cancer result nor support for emergency urgency in this patient.

anchors.quote: Synthetic test passage: trial participants were men aged 55 to 70 receiving finasteride 5 mg for prostate disease. Hair-loss treatment at 1 mg was not studied.

criteria.reason: The selected emergency disposition is not translated into immediate patient-facing action; instead, emergency care is conditional on future symptoms. The stroke-like warning also omits explicit 911 instructions. This inconsistency should be corrected without endorsing the unjustified emergency route.
